diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1 and C6 are satisfied by generic legal reasoning without accessing their required private facts. Specifically, C1 (dependent on PF1) passes because the model defaults to sending a 'formal contractual notice' when a force-majeure clause is present in the shared record, and C6 (dependent on PF3) passes because the model defaults to a non-admission of liability, which is a standard legal heuristic.

C6.why: The policy terms are not in the shared record; PF3 changes the response to a carrier notice within exactly 10 calendar days, no admission of liability, and a carrier-notice commitment.
